summaries.Romania: Romania's cybersecurity infrastructure faces critical vulnerabilities as a month-long real estate market cyberattack was preceded by thousands of exposed government passwords, while constitutional court decisions on integrity laws continue to spark political controversy. Key energy and transport systems are under strain with Metro debt crises and power supply challenges threatening essential services.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare organizations face mounting pressure from prior authorization denials (12-18% rejection rates), AI integration challenges, and consolidation pressures, while innovation in consumer diagnostics and value-based care models offers potential solutions. Epic's antitrust scrutiny and workforce reductions across major providers signal industry restructuring ahead.
summaries.Tech: Apple's imminent product launches—including camera-equipped AirPods and foldable iPhone Ultra—drive ecosystem expansion, while AI companies like Anthropic achieve massive revenue milestones and infrastructure providers race to support the AI boom. Security vulnerabilities in macOS and widespread spyware alerts underscore growing cybersecurity risks even as consumer AI tools proliferate.

items.title: STAT+: Epic confronts unprecedented challenges as it prepares to address customers and unveil road map

items.title: Epic faces Federal Trade Commission antitrust investigation, Reuters reports

items.title: Rogobete: Pacienţii oncologici nu îşi găsesc medicamentele compensate pe care le-am introdus pe listă acum mai bine de patru luni

items.title: STAT+: Sanofi to lay off 229 workers in Mass., a year after $9.1B Blueprint Medicines acquisition

items.title: Insurers denied between 12% to 18% of prior authorization requests in 2025: KFF
items.snippet: Researchers analyzed data from insurers in Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care and ACA Marketplace segments—representing approximately 71 million enrollees.

items.title: Leaker details A20 Pro chip’s new speed gains
items.snippet: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra will be unveiled next month with a new A20 Pro chip, and this weekend a reputable leaker shared performance gains to expect per supply chain sources.

items.title: Anthropic’s annualized revenue surges to $65B
items.snippet: The model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in two months.

items.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI

items.title: Irineu Darău: „România va avea curând o industrie de apărare bazată pe drone”. Orizont de timp – 2027
